enrichment.hook: A Mediterranean and Turkish spot in the Mission serving grilled specialties, mezze, and flatbreads.
enrichment.description: Located at 702 Valencia Street, Anatolian Table offers traditional Turkish and Mediterranean fare including lahmacun, pide, and mezze.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted Korean dining concept planned for San Francisco.
enrichment.description: A business permit was recently filed for Noon at 1700 Post St Ste C, pointing to an upcoming Korean dining experience.

enrichment.hook: A historic Outer Sunset storefront and beach bungalow transformed into a contemporary art gallery and community space.
enrichment.description: Originally opened as a gift and basket shop in 1975, this iconic Outer Sunset cottage was revived in 2024 by artist and curator Graham Woo-Holoch as a platform for contemporary art exhibitions, artist editions, and local community events.

enrichment.hook: An all-day Southern Italian restaurant and patio by the team behind A16 in the former MarketBar space.
enrichment.description: Located in the San Francisco Ferry Building, Lucania is a forthcoming Southern Italian concept featuring house-made pasta, Neapolitan pizza, and an expansive outdoor patio.

enrichment.hook: A specialty artisanal cheese market from the team behind Ferry Plaza Wine Merchant.
enrichment.description: An upcoming artisanal cheese shop and market developed by the team behind the Ferry Plaza Wine Merchant, slated to open in the Ferry Building Marketplace.

enrichment.hook: Installs and manages curated, cashless smart coolers in San Francisco residences, gyms, and workplaces.
enrichment.description: Delta Breeze Amenities is a San Francisco-based company providing unattended-retail solutions by placing sleek, cashless smart coolers stocked with premium drinks and snacks in residential and commercial buildings.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood grocery store located in Ashbury Heights.
enrichment.description: Ashbury Market is a long-standing neighborhood grocery store and market located at 205 Frederick Street in San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: A Jewish diaspora culinary project by chef Spencer Horovitz.
enrichment.description: Hadeem is a pop-up and culinary concept by chef Spencer Horovitz focused on modern interpretations of Jewish diaspora cuisine.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing Chinatown spot serving bubble tea, milk tea, and casual Asian snacks.
enrichment.description: Sweetheart Cafe is a casual neighborhood cafe located on Grant Avenue in San Francisco's Chinatown, offering bubble tea, smoothies, and light bites like popcorn chicken and takoyaki.

enrichment.hook: A fresh food refresh and expansion of Café 15 located inside Bay Padel on Treasure Island.
enrichment.description: Kinse has taken over and expanded upon Café 15 as an umbrella brand for cafes, corporate catering, and meal subscriptions, launching its new Treasure Island location at Bay Padel.

enrichment.hook: An upcoming location for the established San Francisco-based organic bubble tea shop.
enrichment.description: Permit filings indicate a new location for Plentea, known for its organic loose-leaf teas and handcrafted bubble tea beverages.

enrichment.hook: AI insurance startup Corgi is expanding with a second 24-hour cafe location in Dogpatch.
enrichment.description: Operated by AI insurance company Corgi, this upcoming second location at 2146 3rd St. follows their 24/7 FiDi cafe concept and hosted a local artist residency project leading up to its planned rollout.

enrichment.hook: An expansion of the 24/7 startup-focused cafe concept by AI insurance company Corgi.
enrichment.description: Public records and reports indicate that Corgi Cafe is expanding with a new location in the Dogpatch neighborhood near Y Combinator offices.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood Latin shop on 24th Street offering specialty products and goods.
enrichment.description: Tienda La única is a storefront located on 24th Street in San Francisco providing Latin products and goods.

enrichment.hook: A petite-focused fashion and styling brand expanding its footprint in San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Short Story, Inc. is an established personal styling and e-commerce service tailored for petite women. A business permit was recently filed for an address at 27 Maiden Lane.

enrichment.hook: A cozy neighborhood spot on Taraval Street specializing in creative matcha lattes, fruit-infused matcha, and boba toppings.
enrichment.description: Located in San Francisco's Parkside neighborhood, Moriwa Matcha serves a variety of specialty matcha drinks like strawberry, mango, and crème brûlée boba lattes. It operates out of the space formerly occupied by YeYe coconut snacks.

enrichment.hook: An expansion of the popular Sichuan-style noodle truck and eatery expanding into a new FiDi location.
enrichment.description: MOMO noodle is planning a new location at 226 Kearny St in San Francisco, bringing its signature Sichuan spicy dry noodles ('bàn miàn') and modern Chinese street food concepts to the Financial District.

enrichment.hook: A family-owned neighborhood coffee shop near SF State known for house-made syrups and hand-whisked matcha.
enrichment.description: Blue House Cafe is a study-friendly neighborhood coffee shop located at 302 Randolph St in San Francisco, offering specialty drinks like ube and pandan lattes alongside spam musubi.

enrichment.hook: A forthcoming Marina District location for the local French cafe and bakery chain.
enrichment.description: La Boulangerie de San Francisco is expanding to the Marina District at 2300 Chestnut Street, as indicated by upcoming location notices on their official site.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood Italian spot in West Portal serving traditional Southern Italian dishes and house-made pasta.
enrichment.description: Trattoria Da Vittorio offers a menu of classic Italian comfort foods, wood-fired style pizzas, and house-made pastas in San Francisco's West Portal neighborhood.

enrichment.hook: An emerging online-focused brand creating comfort objects, calming gifts, and daily wellness rituals for overthinkers.
enrichment.description: Anxiety Country Club is an initiative founded in San Francisco focused on developing relaxation products, home fragrance, and tools to manage daily stress. Public filings indicate a residential address setup while the venture prepares its initial collections for launch.

enrichment.hook: A hidden hole-in-the-wall Chinese spot tucked away on Waverly Place in San Francisco's Chinatown.
enrichment.description: The Spicy Shrimp serves a menu of traditional Cantonese dishes, noodle soups, congee, and rice plates at 150 Waverly Place.

enrichment.hook: An expansion location for the Oakland-based specialty coffee roaster.
enrichment.description: A new permit filing indicates a location for Black-owned specialty coffee roaster Red Bay Coffee at 780 McDonnell Rd in San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: A wine-forward California bistro taking over the historic former Fog City space on the Embarcadero.
enrichment.description: Planned by hospitality duo Floyd Nunn and Angelyne Tompkins, Moonchild is set to open in late 2026 at the landmark 1300 Battery St. location, focusing on Northern California produce and seafood.

enrichment.hook: A French-inspired champagne lounge coming to San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Maison Bulle is an upcoming French-inspired champagne lounge announced for San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: Popular Filipino-Californian pop-up bakery expanding into its first permanent brick-and-mortar storefront.
enrichment.description: Longtime Bay Area pop-up bakery La Kalidád is graduating from farmers markets and preorders to a permanent café-bakery space in San Francisco's South Beach neighborhood, featuring inventive pastries and specialty drinks.

enrichment.hook: Oakland's popular craft brewery and radler maker is expanding to the Mission District.
enrichment.description: Two Pitchers Brewing Company is planning a new San Francisco taproom at 535 Florida Street. An official opening date has not yet been announced as the project moves through build-out.

enrichment.hook: An Inner Richmond spot serving classic Peruvian coffee, sandwiches, and homemade desserts.
enrichment.description: Located at 200 6th Avenue, Gery's Deli Cafe offers traditional Peruvian fare including specialty coffee drinks, empanadas, tamales, and sandwiches like lomo saltado and pan con pollo.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing SOMA neighborhood staple featuring burgers, cocktails, and heated outdoor patios.
enrichment.description: Mars Bar & Restaurant is a well-established fixture in San Francisco's South of Market district known for its casual American bites, drinks, and versatile event space with outdoor patios.

places.dba_name: Between The Bookends Bookstore And Coffee LLC

enrichment.hook: A medieval-themed independent bookshop focusing on historical fiction, cozy fantasy, and gothic titles.
enrichment.description: An upcoming independent book vendor offering genre-specific titles and medieval-themed wares through online orders and local market pop-ups.

places.dba_name: Coast To Coast Cards And Collectibles
Taqueria Chapala Y Antojitos Inc Dba Taqueria Chapala

enrichment.hook: A family-owned Mexican taqueria serving authentic dishes like tacos, burritos, and quesabirrias in the Sunset District.
enrichment.description: Taqueria Chapala brings traditional Mexican fare—including handmade-style tacos, burritos, and seafood specialties—to Noriega Street in San Francisco's Sunset District.

enrichment.hook: Popular quesabirria specialist expanding to the Fillmore District.
enrichment.description: Known for its Jalisco-style birria tacos and handmade corn tortillas, Tacos El Patron is moving into the former Nia Soul Cafe space on Fillmore Street.

places.dba_name: Compass @ International School Of San Francisco
Sepal Ice Cream Scoops And Cakes

enrichment.hook: A late-night Korean spot serving drinks, pub snacks, and fried chicken in Lower Nob Hill.
enrichment.description: Zzan is a casual Korean dining and drinking establishment on Post Street offering late-night comfort food like fried chicken, stews, and rice cakes.

enrichment.hook: Popular Japanese sando and matcha shop expanding into the Financial District.
enrichment.description: Tadaima is preparing to open its fourth San Francisco location at 113 Sacramento Street, taking over the former Orale Orale space to serve its signature Japanese sandos, onigiri, musubi, and matcha drinks.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing neighborhood establishment at 4300 Mission St offering coffee and casual eats.
enrichment.description: Silver Cafe is an established neighborhood eatery located on Mission Street in San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: Fresh, customizable Mediterranean bowls, wraps, and plates located near the Salesforce business district.
enrichment.description: SAJJ Mediterranean at 71 Stevenson Street offers build-your-own bowls, wraps, and salads featuring proteins like chicken and steak shawarma, falafel, and fresh sides.

enrichment.hook: Traditional French pastries and classic cakes made using organic ingredients and classic techniques.
enrichment.description: Le Carousel Patisserie offers traditional French cakes, croissants, and viennoiserie, operating delivery and pickup via online platforms as well as through café locations like its spot at the Tilden Hotel.

enrichment.hook: An upcoming San Francisco expansion by the established Bay Area specialty coffee roaster.
enrichment.description: A business permit was filed for Highwire Coffee at 555 Bryant St, bringing the popular regional roaster's presence into San Francisco.

enrichment.hook: An authentic Chinese and dim sum restaurant located on Ocean Avenue.
enrichment.description: Golden Coast Restaurant is an established neighborhood eatery on Ocean Avenue serving a variety of Chinese dishes, dim sum, and Cantonese favorites.

places.dba_name: Gainz And Shreds Meal Prep San Francisco

enrichment.hook: Macro-friendly and halal-certified meal prep service expanding to San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Gainz and Shreds Meal Prep announced a new San Francisco location at CloudKitchens on Charter Oak Avenue with an expected opening date of September 15, 2026.

enrichment.hook: An upcoming Ukrainian-owned coffee and breakfast spot transitioning to a wine bar by evening.
enrichment.description: An expansion of Sausalito's Franko & Co., this Union Street concept aims to serve coffee, pastries, and light breakfast items during the day and wine in the evenings.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing neighborhood donut shop serving classic pastries and coffee on 9th Avenue.
enrichment.description: Donut World is an established neighborhood staple located at 1399 9th Ave, offering a wide selection of traditional donuts and baked goods.

enrichment.hook: A planned fusion pizzeria bringing wood-fired crusts and curry toppings to Lombard Street.
enrichment.description: Curry & Crust Pizzeria is registered at 2018 Lombard St, featuring a concept centered around wood-fired pizzas topped with Indian curries. Its online presence indicates that ordering and site development are still underway.

enrichment.hook: Japan's largest anime retailer is opening its first Bay Area location in SF Japantown.
enrichment.description: Animate is expanding to San Francisco with a pop-up and retail presence inside the New People Building, spotlighting fan-favorite anime series and merchandise.

enrichment.hook: Chef Anthony Strong's popular fresh-pasta shop is expanding to a third location in Cole Valley.
enrichment.description: Pasta Supply Co has filed business registration and alcohol license applications to take over a former Peet's Coffee space at 919 Cole St.

enrichment.hook: Organic ceremonial matcha, lattes, and soft serve featured at The Market in San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Oishii Matcha serves organic ceremonial matcha, specialty lattes, and soft serve ice cream at 1355 Market Street within The Market SF collective.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood corner store planned to bring an expanded selection of everyday essentials to the Tenderloin.
enrichment.description: Hyde & Turk Market is planned as a refresh for an existing neighborhood mini market at 161 Hyde Street. Owner Ala Fahd Alghaithi aims to upgrade the store into a more complete neighborhood grocery destination.

enrichment.hook: Popular Mission District breakfast burrito specialist expanding to Lower Nob Hill.
enrichment.description: Al Carajo is expanding from its original 22nd Street location to take over the former Bandit space at 683 Geary Street, with plans to open in the fall.

enrichment.hook: Long-standing custom bespoke tailors operating out of Union Square since the 1970s.
enrichment.description: Seymour's Fashions is an established San Francisco boutique specializing in custom bespoke suits, tuxedos, shirts, and alterations.

enrichment.hook: A family-owned home furnishings and design store expanding to Hayes Valley with a temporary pop-up.
enrichment.description: Cokas Diko Home operates a furniture and decor showroom featuring a relaxed California aesthetic, with a temporary pop-up planned for Hayes Street.

enrichment.hook: An Italian bakery and bagel shop in North Beach from famed pizzaiolo Tony Gemignani.
enrichment.description: Located in North Beach, Toscano Brothers serves naturally leavened sourdough breads, pastries, and New York-style bagels.

enrichment.hook: An established bicycle shop expanding with a San Francisco storefront on Folsom Street.
enrichment.description: The Bike Connection operates a location at 1090 Folsom St, offering bicycle sales, rentals, repairs, and gear.

enrichment.hook: A combination corner store and scratch kitchen serving Philly cheesesteaks, wings, and daily essentials on 6th Street.
enrichment.description: Minna Market & Grill operates as a hybrid neighborhood convenience store and hot food spot, offering cheesesteaks, wings, and fried chicken alongside everyday household basics.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood corner store and liquor shop in the Duboce Triangle area.
enrichment.description: Rosenberg Food & Beverage is an established local market and liquor store located at 276 Noe Street, offering groceries, household goods, snacks, and alcoholic beverages.

enrichment.hook: A sustainable boutique featuring one-of-a-kind clothing and accessories upcycled from vintage Indian saris.
enrichment.description: Luna Wild Collection operates a storefront on Haight Street offering handmade apparel like goddess tops, cropped bombers, and dusters crafted from upcycled textiles.

enrichment.hook: A local family-owned gift shop expanding to the Embarcadero Center.
enrichment.description: LOLA SF is a specialty gift shop offering locally-made items, stationery, books, and accessories, with a new location listed as coming soon at Three Embarcadero Center.

enrichment.hook: A civic center restaurant and lounge at the SF Conservatory of Music's Bowes Center pairing dynamic California-Italian fare with live student performances.
enrichment.description: Located on the ground floor of the SF Conservatory of Music's Bowes Center, Uccello Lounge offers food and drinks alongside live music ranging from jazz standards to classical ensembles.

enrichment.hook: A legendary Lower Haight institution specializing in soul, oldies, and rare 45s.
enrichment.description: Long-running Lower Haight record shop located at 429 Haight St, known for its deep crates of vintage soul, R&B, and rare 45s curated by the late owner Dick Vivian.

enrichment.hook: A Mission District vintage shop specializing in early-to-mid 20th-century workwear, Levi's, and rare collectibles.
enrichment.description: Dead End Vintage is a San Francisco clothing boutique focusing on 20th-century menswear, workwear, and curated apparel like gabardine and Ricky jackets.

enrichment.hook: Popular global cheese-foam and fresh fruit tea chain opening its second San Francisco outpost at Stonestown Galleria.
enrichment.description: Heytea serves modern-style teas made with fresh ingredients, including signature fruit and cheese-foam blends. Its Stonestown Galleria location operates as its second San Francisco storefront.

enrichment.hook: A pop-up vendor bringing Trinbagonian street food doubles to San Francisco.
enrichment.description: An emerging pop-up concept specializing in traditional Trinidadian doubles made with soft bara and channa, operating via platforms like Hotplate and Instagram.

enrichment.hook: San Francisco-based online retailer specializing in dollhouse miniatures, unique home decor, and workspace accessories.
enrichment.description: Inusitus is an e-commerce business offering artisan-inspired products ranging from miniature dollhouse furniture and lighting to decorative rug mouse pads and home goods.

enrichment.hook: Popular fast-food chain taking over the former McDonald's space at Stonestown Galleria.
enrichment.description: Raising Cane's is expanding to San Francisco with a new location at the Stonestown Galleria mall, known for its signature chicken fingers and Cane's sauce.

enrichment.hook: A massive new flagship location for the fast-growing chicken finger chain coming to Fisherman's Wharf.
enrichment.description: Raising Cane's is opening a multi-level flagship restaurant at 211 Jefferson Street in the heart of San Francisco's Fisherman's Wharf.

enrichment.hook: A second location and sandwich-focused concept from Bernal Heights' popular Black Jet Baking Co.
enrichment.description: Black Jet Baking Co. is expanding to the Outer Sunset into the former DamnFine Coffee space, planning to offer housemade pastries alongside a new rotating sandwich menu and savory items.

enrichment.hook: A specialty neighborhood grocer in Ingleside bringing unique Mexican and Central American items.
enrichment.description: El Mercadito took over the storefront at 1712 Ocean Ave., offering fresh produce, pantry staples, household items, and specialized Central American products.

enrichment.hook: A historic, long-running 24-hour diner in the heart of San Francisco's Castro district.
enrichment.description: Operating since 1977, this classic retro diner serves comfort food, breakfast items, and late-night bites. It recently transitioned to new ownership under Michael Goodrich.

enrichment.hook: NYC-style halal street food operating out of the SoMa Food Court.
enrichment.description: Naz's Halal Food serves a menu of chicken and lamb rice platters, gyros, sandwiches, and fast-food comfort items at 475 6th Street.

enrichment.hook: A modern French épicerie and café in Jackson Square specializing in pâté en croûte and viennoiserie.
enrichment.description: Maison Nico is a French-inspired market and café helmed by Michelin-starred chef Nicolas Delaroque, offering sophisticated terrines, pâtés en croûte, and fine pastries.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing neighborhood spot serving old-school Chinese comfort food and large portions in the Mission.
enrichment.description: Heung Yuen Restaurant is an established casual eatery located on 22nd Street, known for offering traditional Chinese dishes, clay pots, noodles, and family-style meals.

enrichment.hook: The beloved Filipino fast-food giant finally makes its triumphant return to San Francisco after a six-year wait.
enrichment.description: Located right on Market Street near the Powell BART station, this long-awaited flagship brings massive crowds, overnight lines, and its signature Chickenjoy fried chicken back to the city. Diners can dig into cult favorites like sweet-style Jolly Spaghetti and Peach Mango Pies.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted Vietnamese-style coffee concept planned for Lower Nob Hill.
enrichment.description: Culi Caphe is currently in the early setup and permitting phases following its business registration in June 2026. It aims to bring specialty Vietnamese coffee varieties to the neighborhood.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted spot on Illinois Street in San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Buenafe #1 has filed a business permit for 1197 Illinois St, though it remains under development with no official opening date announced yet.

enrichment.hook: A newly incorporated neighborhood corner shop and liquor store coming to the intersection near North Panhandle / Western Addition.
enrichment.description: Jack's Market & Liquor Inc recently filed corporate and business paperwork in San Francisco. Build-out and licensing are expected to be underway.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted Korean noodle concept eyed for the Alemany Boulevard corridor.
enrichment.description: Jeong's Noodle Sfo filed a business permit in mid-2026 for a location at 3995 Alemany Blvd. Build-out and preparation are likely underway.

enrichment.hook: The popular Bay Area fast-casual brand launches its very first airport location.
enrichment.description: The Melt has officially opened its doors at SFO's Harvey Milk Terminal 1, serving up signature Angus and Wagyu MeltBurgers, grilled cheese, and exclusive airport menu items like breakfast sandwiches and a charity-supporting Harvey Milkshake.

enrichment.hook: A mission-driven street art and apparel brand aiming to fund local transitional housing through retail and media.
enrichment.description: Iheartsf combines local tattoo and graffiti art-inspired merchandise with a community podcast to build an innovative social impact business model. Following its business permit filing, the brand continues to develop its operations.

enrichment.hook: A fresh-packed sushi counter setting up inside Glen Park's neighborhood favorite, Canyon Market.
enrichment.description: Afc Sushi is slated to bring its convenient, grab-and-go supermarket sushi counters to Canyon Market on Diamond Street following a recent permit filing.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted venture eyeing the historic Haight Street space.
enrichment.description: 1984 Cellars is a recently registered business entity with a permit filed at 1801 Haight St, though public operational details remain sparse as it undergoes early setup.

enrichment.hook: Corporate headquarters and offices for the popular direct-to-consumer bra and intimates brand.
enrichment.description: ThirdLove, Inc. maintains its corporate and principal business offices at this downtown San Francisco location. Known for pioneering half-cup sizing and inclusive fit solutions, the company operates its core operations here.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted boutique concept on Pacific Avenue blending confections with plant nursery elements.
enrichment.description: Sweets By Tyson's Nursery is currently moving through early establishment phases following its recent business permit filing.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted venue slated for the historic Art Deco skyscraper at 140 New Montgomery Street.
enrichment.description: Sutro Hall is a newly registered business entity undergoing early development and build-out in downtown San Francisco. Public details remain sparse as it progresses past its initial June 2026 permit filing.

enrichment.hook: A fresh wine concept slated for the historic Lower Haight corner previously held by Two Jack's Nik's Place.
enrichment.description: Passages Wine is currently undergoing initial setup following a business permit filing in mid-2026 at 401 Haight Street. Details on its exact opening timeline and official concept remain under wraps.

enrichment.hook: Longtime Mission District staple Mission: Comics is expanding with the Excelsior neighborhood's very first comic book shop.
enrichment.description: Fueled in part by a city storefront-activation grant, the beloved independent shop is branching out into a former optometry office at 5196 Mission St. Owner Leef Smith, who grew up in the neighborhood, plans to bring graphic novels, indie comix, and pop culture art to a historically underserved area.
